6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: Wiktor Smolak, Jorga Azmal and a handful of their ministers joined us around the conference table.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: A short while later, we reconvened with Jorga Azmal around the table. This time, we were joined by Wiktor Smolak and his entourage.

8.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
8.text: "Gentlemen. I know it has been historically difficult for Wehlen and Derdia to find common ground."

10.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
10.text: "I have no idea what you mean, Mr. Esquibel. Derdians are always welcome in my republic."

11.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
11.text: "Or they would be, were it not for their troublesome associations with the Bludish Freedom Front."

15.speaker: Jorga Azmal
15.text: "The same Bludish Freedom Front that your cruel military operation all but eliminated?"

16.speaker: Jorga Azmal
16.text: "We understand the BFF has caused problems for you in the past. But we feel for the innocent Bluds who got caught in the crossfire during your single-minded pursuit of the organization."

20.speaker: Jorga Azmal
20.text: "With help from His Majesty, I might add."

24.speaker: Jorga Azmal
24.text: "A pursuit aided by His Majesty, I might add."

25.speaker: Player_Romus
25.text: "Have you or have you not been harboring BFF terrorists within your borders, Azmal?"

26.speaker: Player_Romus
26.text: "The BFF are not true Golcondists, Supreme Wiseman. They're mere puppets of superpowers who want to destabilize Wehlen."

27.speaker: Player_Romus
27.text: "Yes, President Smolak, you can't use the BFF as justification for animosity towards Derdia now that they no longer pose a threat."

28.speaker: Player_Romus
28.text: "You cannot wave away the threat that the BFF still poses to Wehlen."

29.speaker: Jorga Azmal
29.text: "We give shelter to Golcondists in need. We keep no record of their pasts."

30.speaker: Player_Romus
30.text: "I did find Operation Bear Trap rather over the top, President Smolak."

31.speaker: Jorga Azmal
31.text: "So many Golcondists have died. Am I wrong in fearing that Derdia will be next?"

32.speaker: Jorga Azmal
32.text: "As I said at the Alliance of Nations, there is only one superpower that I believe in. And He has blessed the Bluds on their holly mission."

33.speaker: Jorga Azmal
33.text: "Nor can we condemn our fellow Golcondists for fighting for their beliefs."

34.speaker: Jorga Azmal
34.text: "Over the top?! That's all the criticism the King of Rizia can manage?"

35.speaker: Player_Romus
35.text: "Operation Bear Trap raised alarms for us here in Rizia as well."

36.speaker: Jorga Azmal
36.text: "Yet not enough for you to cut ties with Wehlen."

38.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
38.text: "The BFF is a volatile topic. Which is precisely why we should not be talking about it."

39.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
39.text: "Let us focus instead on what Derdia and Wehlen can do for each other, and what the Kingdom of Rizia can do for you both."

40.speaker: Narrator
40.text: Both men were silent. They nodded warily.

41.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
41.text: "A longstanding point of contention has been Derdians gaining passage to Deyr in Sordland."

47.speaker: Player_Romus
47.text: "Why has Wehlen been blocking the Derdians on their holy pilgrimage, President Smolak?"

48.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
48.text: "The Archsanctuay of Deyr is first and foremost a Dastnurist site, Your Majesty."

49.speaker: Player_Romus
49.text: "Ah, yes. Our most holy of holy sites."

51.speaker: Narrator
51.text: Azmal and Smolak gave me flabbergasted stares.

52.speaker: Jorga Azmal
52.text: "It is our holiest of holy sites, Your Majesty. Where God delivered His message to Saint Dast."

53.speaker: Jorga Azmal
53.text: "The Archsanctuary of Deyr is where Nurity as a whole came to be. Every true believer must visit it at least once, no matter their denomination."

54.speaker: Jorga Azmal
54.text: "Yet it is said that every true believer in Nurity must visit it at least once. Wruhecists included."

55.speaker: Player_Romus
55.text: "It sounds like that's a problem for the Sords, not the Rizians."

56.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
56.text: "I wish it were that easy. My friend Anton would solve this in an instant."

60.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
60.text: "Except that Derdians must pass through Wehlen to reach Deyr."

61.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
61.text: "It is the site of God's descension to Saint Dast. And therefore of particular importance to Dastnurists, not Wruhecists."

62.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
62.text: "Hmm. It's funny how your beloved St. Wruhec didn't come up once in that description."

63.speaker: Jorga Azmal
63.text: "Your 'friend' couldn't even get the Descension Day ceremony right."

67.speaker: Jorga Azmal
67.text: "And why should I trust a man who harbors the same murderous intentions as you?"

68.speaker: Jorga Azmal
68.text: "If there was another way to get there, we would use it."

70.speaker: Player_Romus
70.text: "The Derdians don't have to pass through Wehlen to reach Deyr. We could help them find a sea route."

71.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
71.text: "Yes, I've looked into the possibility. It would go from Yol through the Sudis Sea all the way around to Lachaven."

72.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
72.text: "Sordland would have to agree to it. But we're on good terms with them right now."

76.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
76.text: "The problem is that Sordland would have to agree with it. And we're not on the best of terms right now."

80.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
80.text: "And we can supply the ships ourselves."

81.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
81.text: "The problem is that we don't have enough ships to spare."

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "Your corridor solution worked with Morella, Laurento. Can we not do the same thing with Wehlen?"

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "Let's get creative. There must be something that Wehlen would accept in exchange for allowing Derdians through to Sordland."

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "Laurento, your corridor solution may not have worked with Morella, but could it work with Wehlen?"
90.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn09_MorellaDerdiaMediation_Success"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn09_MorellaDerdiaMediation_Failed"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_WehlenDerdia_Corridor"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] >= 1) == false)

92.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
92.text: "President Smolak, His Majesty is referring to the creation of a secure corridor through Wehlen. Derdian pilgrims would be able to pass into Sordland using this route and this route only."

93.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
93.text: "Keeping your Golcondists from fraternizing with ours. Yes, I like it."

94.speaker: Jorga Azmal
94.text: "It has yet to be implemented in Morella. But I have high hopes for it."

98.speaker: Jorga Azmal
98.text: "I did not agree to the idea before, and I do not understand why it is being proposed again now."

102.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
102.text: "Sounds like a ringing endorsement, Supreme Wiseman."

103.speaker: Jorga Azmal
103.text: "Prime Minister Saltana did not agree to the idea. I myself was open to it."

111.speaker: Player_Romus
111.text: "What if Rizia oversees the security of some kind of prayer corridor through Wehlen?"
111.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn09_MorellaDerdiaMediation_Success"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn09_MorellaDerdiaMediation_Failed"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_WehlenDerdia_Corridor"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] >= 1) == false)

112.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
112.text: "Yes, that's one idea my department had."

113.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
113.text: "We would plot a route through Wehlen known as 'St. Wruhec's Corridor'. Derdian pilgrims would be able to pass into Sordland using this route and this route only."

117.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
117.text: "Unfortunately, we can't spare the military manpower to ensure the security of the route."

121.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
121.text: "We have the military manpower to make sure the route is secure."

122.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
122.text: "Rizia would be responsible for the route's security."

123.speaker: Jorga Azmal
123.text: "So long as your forces were able to keep Wehlen from blocking our journey, I would agree to this."

127.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
127.text: "Or we can contract an independent security company."

128.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
128.text: "But we have the budget to contract an independent security company."

130.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
130.text: "We want Derdia to buy our oil."

131.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
131.text: "We are still suffering the effects of the GRACE embargo on us, among other sanctions."

135.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
135.text: "We have been the subject of unfair sanctions. But we have plenty of energy to spare for the right customer."

136.speaker: Jorga Azmal
136.text: "It is no secret that Derdia needs energy, Mr. President."

137.speaker: Jorga Azmal
137.text: "All the more so since Rizia failed to deliver on its energy promises."

148.speaker: Jorga Azmal
148.text: "Although not as much as we used to, thanks to our recent deal with Rizia."

149.speaker: Player_Romus
149.text: "My kingdom would be very happy to supply the expertise and infrastructure for an oil pipeline between your two nations."

150.speaker: Jorga Azmal
150.text: "But we cannot afford the infrastructure that such an agreement would require."
150.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_EnergyCommitment_Derdia_Failed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_EnergyCommitment_Wehlen_Failed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Derdia"] == true) == false)

151.speaker: Player_Romus
151.text: "Perhaps you could supply Wehlen with missiles to raise the needed funds."

152.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
152.text: "No offense, Your Majesty, but Wehlen has no need for Derdian missiles. Have you seen our arsenal?"

153.speaker: Player_Romus
153.text: "If Wehlen is so desperate to sell oil, they should pay for the pipeline themselves."

157.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
157.text: "I can agree to fund part of it. But not all."

165.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
165.text: "Between our two nations, we can definitely afford this."

166.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
166.text: "Even then, I am not certain Rizia can afford it."

171.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
171.text: "I am not certain Rizia can afford it."

172.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
172.text: "Unfortunate. It could've been a pivotal step forward in the South Merkopan alliance we are building."

173.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
173.text: "Such a deal could be a pivotal step forward in the South Merkopan alliance we are building."

174.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
174.text: "Your Majesty, Rizia should consider funding this pipeline. If we can afford it, that is."

175.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
175.text: "If we were that desperate, Your Majesty, you would have had Zille back five years ago."

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] >= 1) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_WehlenDerdia_Pipeline"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_WehlenDerdia_Corridor"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_WehlenDerdia_SeaRoute"] == true)

185.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
185.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_WehlenDerdia_Pipeline"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_WehlenDerdia_Corridor"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_WehlenDerdia_SeaRoute"] == true) == false

186.speaker: Narrator
186.text: Both Azmal and Smolak leaned forward to listen to me.

190.speaker: Player_Romus
190.text: "We will fund a secure prayer corridor from Derdia through Wehlen to Sordland." [-1 Budget]

191.speaker: Player_Romus
191.text: "We will send troops to oversee the security of a Golcondist prayer corridor through Wehlen." [-250 Manpower]

198.speaker: Player_Romus
198.text: "We will create a sea route for Golcondist pilgrims to reach Sordland without having to cross into Wehlen." [-1 Ships]

202.speaker: Player_Romus
202.text: "Together with Wehlen, we will fund an oil pipeline between Wehlen and Derdia. A secure Derdian pilgrimage route will be a condition for this new energy partnership." [-2 Budget]

203.speaker: Player_Romus
203.text: "We will fund an oil pipeline between Wehlen and Derdia. A secure Derdian pilgrimage route will be a condition for this new energy partnership." [-2 Budget]

204.speaker: Player_Romus
204.text: "Your nations must practice trust and cooperation. Remember, we all pray to the same God."

208.speaker: Player_Romus
208.text: "You must fight a Derdian Duel of Generosity."

209.speaker: Narrator
209.text: Wiktor Smolak's eyes lit up with glee. He stood up and started punching the air.

210.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
210.text: "I've always wanted to do one of these! Will you be your own champion, Supreme Wiseman?"

211.speaker: Jorga Azmal
211.text: "No! Both of you will stop insulting myself and my religion."

213.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
213.text: "We didn't need to come to Rizia to hear that."

214.speaker: Jorga Azmal
214.text: "This was a waste of both of our time."

215.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
215.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn08_MediateDerdiaWehlen_MinimalEffort"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn09_MorellaDerdiaMediation_Success"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn09_MorellaDerdiaMediation_Success"] == true) == false)

226.speaker: Player_Romus
226.text: "I thank the Lord for watching over today's talks."

231.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
231.text: "Hrm. That's the best you can do?"

232.speaker: Player_Romus
232.text: "It is. Take it or leave it." [-1 Authority]

239.speaker: Player_Romus
239.text: "If it helps, Rizia will allocate additional funding towards the project." [-1 Budget]

243.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
243.text: "Hrm. That's the best you can do?"

244.speaker: Player_Romus
244.text: "It is. Take it or leave it." [-1 Authority]

251.speaker: Player_Romus
251.text: "If it helps, Rizia will allocate additional funding towards the project." [-1 Budget]

257.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
257.text: "Hrm. That's the best you can do?"

258.speaker: Player_Romus
258.text: "It is. Take it or leave it." [-1 Authority]

265.speaker: Player_Romus
265.text: "If it helps, Rizia will allocate additional funding towards the project." [-1 Budget]

271.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
271.text: "Hrm. That's the best you can do?"

272.speaker: Player_Romus
272.text: "It is. Take it or leave it." [-1 Authority]

279.speaker: Player_Romus
279.text: "If it helps, Rizia will allocate additional funding towards the project." [-2 Budget]

285.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
285.text: "Hrm. That's the best you can do?"

286.speaker: Player_Romus
286.text: "It is. Take it or leave it." [-2 Authority]

293.speaker: Player_Romus
293.text: "If it helps, Rizia will allocate additional funding towards the project." [-1 Budget]

300.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
300.text: "Then our efforts today were in vain."

302.speaker: Player_Romus
302.text: "I am sorry Rizia could not have been more helpful."

303.speaker: Player_Romus
303.text: "I hope this will not impact our efforts to form the South Merkopan Alliance."

304.speaker: Player_Romus
304.text: "It was nonetheless a pleasure to see you both."

305.speaker: Player_Romus
305.text: "I hope you can still assure us a safe return of the Zille territory, Mr. Smolak."

312.speaker: Jorga Azmal
312.text: "Your willingness to help Derdia and Morella shows that your efforts are in good faith."

313.speaker: Jorga Azmal
313.text: "Two failed mediations in one day? That is truly not a good omen."

315.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
315.text: "A deal with Derdia would have been a mere bonus."

327.speaker: Jorga Azmal
327.text: "I thank you nonetheless for your help with Morella."

328.speaker: Jorga Azmal
328.text: "Two failed mediations in one day. The Lord has not blessed Rizia with the gift of diplomacy."

332.speaker: Jorga Azmal
332.text: "You have both failed the Golcondists. You will be judged poorly for it at the end of your days."

333.speaker: Narrator
333.text: Smolak eagerly reached out his hand. Azmal shook it.

334.speaker: Narrator
334.text: A Wehzek khisha pipe was standing in the corner of the room. An aide moved it to our table.

335.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
335.text: "How thoughtful of Your Majesty! But I really must be going."

336.speaker: Jorga Azmal
336.text: "Praise be to He who unites the universe."

340.speaker: Player_Romus
340.text: "I hope this means I can count on both of your countries' cooperation in the formation of a South Merkopan alliance."

341.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
341.text: "Very gladly. Together, we will make Rumburg regret its decision to mess with us!"

342.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
342.text: "Such modesty. All praise must go to King Romus!"

343.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
343.text: "I'm up to my elbows in paperwork for the Zille transition. My citizens have so many concerns. You know how it is."

346.speaker: Player_Romus
346.text: "I look forward to that day, President Smolak."

347.speaker: Player_Romus
347.text: "You had better not be planning any last-minute surprises."

348.speaker: Player_Romus
348.text: "Rest assured that Rizia shall make the transition as smooth as possible."

350.speaker: Narrator
350.text: He bowed and left the suite.

351.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
351.text: "There is no doubt in my mind."

355.speaker: Jorga Azmal
355.text: "I am truly grateful for all your help today, Your Majesty. Thanks to Rizia, the great Republic of Derdia shall finally be brought out of isolation."

360.speaker: Jorga Azmal
360.text: "I am truly grateful for your help today, Your Majesty. I would never have thought Wehlen would be a more cooperative partner than Morella."

361.speaker: Player_Romus
361.text: "Life is full of surprises, Supreme Wiseman."

362.speaker: Jorga Azmal
362.text: "I am grateful for your help today, Your Majesty. Thanks to Rizia, the great Republic of Derdia shall finally be brought out of isolation."

363.speaker: Player_Romus
363.text: "Together, we shall take on the world."

365.speaker: Player_Romus
365.text: "Wiktor is an unusual fellow. But he holds true to his word."

366.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
366.text: "I'm up to my elbows in paperwork for the Zille transition. My citizens have so many concerns. You know how it is."

367.speaker: Player_Romus
367.text: "I look forward to that day, President Smolak."

368.speaker: Player_Romus
368.text: "You had better not be planning any last-minute surprises."

369.speaker: Player_Romus
369.text: "Rest assured that Rizia shall make the transition as smooth as possible."

371.speaker: Narrator
371.text: He bowed as Laurento escorted him out of the suite. I sat alone with Azmal for a long minute.

372.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
372.text: "There is no doubt in my mind."

373.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
373.text: "Sorry to cut this party short, but I really must be going."

377.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
377.text: "I'm working hard to conclude our agreed-upon transfer for Zille. There are a few paperwork challenges left but all is going splendidly."

390.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
390.text: "Unfortunate. But surely there's another way forward."

391.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
391.text: "Brokering a connection between Wehlen and Derdia could be beneficial for everyone involved."
